exchanges: hey, quiet day here
Quiet days can be really nice.
freelance illustrator life means i havent left the house since tuesday
Sounds like you could use a little time outside.
love living in brackenridge tho, so quiet at night
A peaceful place to live makes all the difference.
deadline friday, panicking slightly
You've got this, one piece at a time.
made a huge pot of chili to survive the week
Smart move, chili gets better every day.
cleo next door bought a canoe and she doesnt even live near water
Ha, maybe she's planning a road trip.
it's just sitting on her lawn lol
Very decorative at least.
my twin rasmus is turning into our dad, it's scary
Ha, it happens to the best of us.
he started ironing his jeans
That's a big sign, for sure.
cleo from book club bought a kiln for her garage, she's gone full pottery
That's commitment, she must be loving it.
she promised me a mug
A handmade mug is a great gift.
my twin just announced he's moving to dunedin, mum is in shock
Big news, that's a long way to go.
i kind of get it though, he's always wanted to travel
It's good he's chasing what he wants.
dusted off my accordion last night, the neighbours must love me
Ha, a bit of music never hurt anyone.
rusty but it came back fast
Muscle memory is amazing like that.
my friend bea's little boy lorcan drew me a dragon
That's so sweet, definitely one for the fridge.
honestly better than some of my work
Kids have a fearless style.
smell of seaweed always takes me right back to growing up in tarbert
Smells are powerful for bringing memories back.
taking the tram to the shared studio every day now, actual human contact
Good for you, a change of scene helps.
deadline met!!
Congrats, that's a huge relief.
my twin still uses a nokia brick, refuses to get a smartphone
There's something charming about that.
bea's had bonobo on in the car every time she picks me up
Sounds like a good soundtrack for a drive.
dinner with her family tomorrow
That'll be lovely.
ok im off to sleep
Night, rest well.
